SysDataModelXML.ModelDesc: 批量导入粘贴收货明细
SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS --LINKNOGROUP SELECT XWS.PK_0 LINKROWID ,CAST(XWS.QTYPCU_0 AS REAL) 收货数量 ,XWS.LOC_0 收货库位 ,XWS.SERNUM_0 序列号 ,XWS.BPSLOT_0 供应商批次 ,XWS.RPNUM_0 收货单号 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), XWS.CREDATTIM_0, 21) 操作时间 ,XWS.USERID_0 操作人员 ,CASE WHEN XWS.LOC_0 = '' THEN N'lang:{zh:收货库位为空,en:Receiving location is empty,de:Eingangslagerplatz ist leer}' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.SERNUM_0 = '' THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号为空,en:Serial number is empty,de:Seriennummer ist leer}' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.QTYPCU_0 <> 1 THEN N'lang:{zh:数量错误,en:Quantity error,de:Mengenfehler}' WHEN ISNULL(SER.NUM, 0) > 1 THEN N'lang:{zh:该序列号重复存在,en:Serial number duplicate exists,de:Seriennummer existiert doppelt}' ELSE '' END AS 数据检查 ,CASE WHEN XWS.LOC_0 = '' THEN N'#E0AFA1' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.SERNUM_0 = '' THEN N'#E0AFA1' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.QTYPCU_0 <> 1 THEN N'#E0AFA1' WHEN ISNULL(SER.NUM, 0) > 1 THEN N'#E0AFA1' ELSE '' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR ,CASE WHEN XWS.RPFLG_0 = 3 THEN 'mui-hidden' ELSE '' END LINKROWIDBTNFLG FROM XWSPTH XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON XWS.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) NUM ,ITMREF_0 ,SERNUM_0 FROM XWSPTH WHERE SERNUM_0 <> '' GROUP BY ITMREF_0 ,SERNUM_0)SER ON SER.ITMREF_0 = XWS.ITMREF_0 AND SER.SERNUM_0 = XWS.SERNUM_0 WHERE XWS.POHNUM_0 = '{0}' AND XWS.POPLIN_0 = '{1}' ORDER BY XWS.RPFLG_0, XWS.CREDATTIM_0
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKEDITMODE UPDATE XWSPTH SET LOC_0='@收货库位@' ,BPSLOT_0='@供应商批次@' ,QTYUOM_0=0@收货数量@ ,QTYSTU_0=0@收货数量@ ,QTYPCU_0=0@收货数量@ ,SERNUM_0='@序列号@' WHERE PK_0='#LINKROWID#'

X5DLIN_0, STA_0, PCU_0, QTYPCU_0, QTYUNI_0, LOC_0, LOT_0, BPSLOT_0, PALNUM_0, CTRNUM_0, SERNUM_0, CREDATTIM_0, UPDDATTIM_0, AUUID_0, CREUSR_0, UPDUSR_0, QTYWEU_0, WRH_0, XTXT_0, XTXT_1, XTXT_2,
